title: Warehouse Management System Outage Response
description: Warehouse Management System outages affecting logistics operations
triggers: Complete WMS outage affecting warehouse operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on warehouse operations and shipping
Implement manual warehouse procedures if needed
investigation_steps: Review WMS application logs and status
resolution_steps: Restart WMS services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply WMS patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with WMS vendor for complex issues
verification: Test WMS functionality at affected warehouses
Confirm with warehouse staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Warehouse outages affecting shipping cutoffs must be treated as P1
Coordinate with local warehouse management before restarting network equipment
Manual procedures may impact inventory accuracy
Maintain operational safety during system restoration
